explanation: The original axis_adapter had a functional defect in the narrowing path (64-bit to 8-bit). The tlast/tuser signals were incorrectly asserted on disabled bytes (keep=0) and the state machine would terminate early when encountering a keep=0 segment, causing data loss. The fix introduces a last_keep_index register that records the index of the last keep=1 in the input word. This index is computed combinationally when a new input word is accepted (in the IDLE state for narrowing). The tlast/tuser outputs are then asserted only when the current cycle matches this index. The termination condition in TRANSFER_OUT is simplified to only transition to IDLE after the last cycle (cycle_count_reg == CYCLE_COUNT-1), ensuring all bytes are transmitted. The changes are confined to the narrowing branch and preserve the existing expanding logic and parameterized structure.
